--DECLARE @FromDate Date = '2022-07-01'; --DECLARE @ToDate Date = '2022-07-31'; --DECLARE @PeriodID INT = 1; --DROP TABLE #mycte
select * ,isnull((select top 1 CustomerCategory from Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID = Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID where AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = fintab.CustomerID ),'NIll') as CustomerCategory ,case when ClosingAmount < 0 then ClosingAmount else 0 end as ClosingCredit ,case when ClosingAmount > 0 then ClosingAmount else 0 end as ClosingDebit INTO #mycte from ( select distinct LastTab.CompanyID, LastTab.CustomerID, LastTab.EmployeeCode, LastTab.CustomerName ,case when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0))) + sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))) < 0 then 'Credit' when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0))) + sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))) > 0 then 'Debit' end as ClosingAmountType ,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID as BusinessPartnerTypeCode ,LastTab.BusinessPartnerName ,(Select Description from GL_CodeCombinationDetail where GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID ) as CodeDescription , 'NOTChecked' as OrderBy ,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years,Type,CrDr , case when Type = 'Activity' then SUM(ISNULL(ActivityDebit,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(ActivityCredit,0)) when Type = 'Opening' then SUM(ISNULL(OpeningDebit,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(OpeningCredit,0)) end as ClosingAmount from ( select (Select companyID from AR_SET_Customer as tbl_Customer where tbl_Customer.Status = 1 and tbl_Customer.CustomerID = OuterTab.CustomerID) as CompanyID , OuterTab.CustomerID, OuterTab.CustomerName, OuterTab.EmployeeCode, OuterTab.BusinessPartnerName, case when outertab.Type = 'Activity' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.CreditAmount, 0)) end as ActivityCredit, case when outertab.Type = 'Activity' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.DebitAmount, 0)) end as ActivityDebit, case when outertab.Type = 'Opening' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.CreditAmount, 0)) end as OpeningCredit, case when outertab.Type = 'Opening' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.DebitAmount, 0)) end as OpeningDebit ,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years ,outertab.Type,CrDr from ( select tab.CustomerID, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.CustomerName, tab.BusinessPartnerName, case when tab.CrDr = 'Credit' then sum(isnull(tab.Amount, 0)) end CreditAmount, case when tab.CrDr = 'Debit' then sum(isnull(tab.Amount, 0)) end DebitAmount, 'Opening' as Type , 'Opening' as MonthNames, '1' MonthNum, '1' as Years,null as crdr from (
select AR_SET_Customer.Customerid, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (1) and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (7,202,220,221,222,223,224,225,226,228,229,230,231,232,233,234,235) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1)
And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType like 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount, 'Credit' as CrDr from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (1) and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status =1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (7,202,220,221,222,223,224,225,226,228,229,230,231,232,233,234,235) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1) And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType like 'Credit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
group by
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,SUM(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) as Amount ,'Credit' as CrDr from dbo.AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (1) and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (7,202,220,221,222,223,224,225,226,228,229,230,231,232,233,234,235) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1) And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all
------------ Payment (Debit) (Payment Vendor Invoice) ----------
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,sum(isnull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)) - isnull(( select sum(Amount) from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail where AP_PaymentSupplierDetail .PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration,'') = 'GST' ),0) as Amount ,'Debit' as CrDr from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.periodID = AP_PaymentHeader.periodID
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AP_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID where AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (1) and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and (SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Vendor Invoice%' Or SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Payment Against %') and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (7,202,220,221,222,223,224,225,226,228,229,230,231,232,233,234,235) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1)
And AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments is null
and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID,AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID,AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
-- Payment (Debit)
union All
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
,(Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then SUM(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) end) as Amount ,'Debit' as CrDr from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1
inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.paymentId = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
where AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (1) and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.status = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.status = 1
and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (7,202,220,221,222,223,224,225,226,228,229,230,231,232,233,234,235) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1) And AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments is null and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType
-- payment Adavnce Against PO (Debit)
union all SELECT AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, sum((Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end)) - isnull(( select sum(Amount) from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail where AP_PaymentSupplierDetail .PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration,'') = 'GST' ),0) as Amount ,'Debit' as CrDr
FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID and (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID or AP_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is null) inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit'
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (1) AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and AP_PaymentHeader.statusCode = 1 and SET_DocumentType.documenttype not like '%invoice%' and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (7,202,220,221,222,223,224,225,226,228,229,230,231,232,233,234,235) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1) And AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments is null
GROUP BY AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID,AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID,AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
-- Payment (Credit)
union All
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
,(Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Credit' then SUM(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) * 1 end) as Amount ,'Credit' as CrDr from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1
inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.paymentId = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode where AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in (1) and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.status = 1
and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (7,202,220,221,222,223,224,225,226,228,229,230,231,232,233,234,235) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1) And AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments is null and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1
group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType
) tab
group by tab.CustomerID, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.CustomerName, tab.CrDr, tab.BusinessPartnerName
union all
select
tab.CustomerID,tab.EmployeeCode,tab.CustomerName,tab.BusinessPartnerName , case when tab.CrDr = 'Credit' then SUM( isnull (tab.Amount , 0 ) )end CreditAmount
, case when tab.CrDr = 'Debit' then sum( ISNULL( tab.Amount ,0 ) ) end DebitAmount
,'Activity' as Type ,MonthNames, MonthNum, Years ,tab.CrDr from (
select
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,sum ( AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount ) as Amount ,'Debit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (1) and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status =1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (7,202,220,221,222,223,224,225,226,228,229,230,231,232,233,234,235) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1) And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType like 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate
union all
select
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,sum ( AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount ) as Amount ,'Credit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in (1) and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status =1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (7,202,220,221,222,223,224,225,226,228,229,230,231,232,233,234,235) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1) And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null
and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType like 'Credit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate
union all
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,case when (select DocumentType from Set_documentTYpe where Set_documentTYpe.Status= 1 And Set_documentTYpe.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_documentTYpe.Companyid = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Companyid) like 'Receipt Against Sale%' then ( (select sum(Amount) from AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1) ) else SUM(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount)
end as Amount ,'Credit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years from dbo.AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
